work.name: Nissan Motor Corporation
work.summary: Designs, develops, and modernizes enterprise applications that support automotive dealership operations: customer onboarding and validation, document management, used-car valuation, workshop workflows (bodywork, paint, mechanics), vehicle reception and delivery, and operational reporting. Works with .NET and .NET MVC, SQL Server, and Dapper—writing optimized queries, managing transactions (including multi-transactional onboarding flows where a record travels from the group's database to each branch's database), and creating tables for new processes. On the front end, implements interfaces with Bootstrap, TailwindCSS, Alpine.js, jQuery, and vimesh-ui, handling local state and authentication.
highlights: Modernized and migrated internal applications on .NET and .NET MVC
Developed with SQL Server and Dapper: optimized queries, transactions, and table design
Multi-transactional onboarding: group database → branch database per location
Customer document management with AI-assisted validation during onboarding
Vehicle reception-to-delivery workflows with automated PDF reporting
Used-car valuation module integrated with the vehicle acquisition pipeline
Service order and appointment dashboards with automated email templates
Front end with Bootstrap, TailwindCSS, Alpine.js, jQuery, and vimesh-ui, with local state management
Production debugging and coordinated rollouts across multiple sites
Used AI assistants and agents (opencode) to automate repetitive tasks and accelerate delivery
Continuous process improvement focused on business outcomes and end-user experience
Applied SOLID, Clean Code, and Dependency Injection in production code

Operated Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, and enterprise DNS
Managed databases with Prisma and Sequelize
External system for CUC Mexico City: payments, scheduling, receipts, contracts
Internal warehouse systems with relational modeling
